method: Reyes public date < earliest indexed external exact-phrase occurrence; obvious hyphen/dash variants are treated as equivalent. For a canonical headword that explicitly bundles named aliases, the aliases are also checked so a synthetic combined label cannot manufacture lexical priority. Negative search results are not proof of universal historical coinage.
